decisions.decision: Propose Ephemeral Quarantine & Dual-Phase Promotion (EQ-2PP) + Contract-Enforced Invariant Proofs (CEIP) as primary build direction
decisions.reason: Avoids 50% originality penalty from cloning GitHub/Foremerge; aligns with Cloudflare physical constraints (no server-side merge API, asynchronous non-blocking events, 128MB DO RAM limits, per-agent repo sharding)
decisions.outcome: Published research/antigravity/independent-challenge.md; dispatched critiques A-R1-CHALLENGE-CLAUDE and A-R1-CHALLENGE-CODEX
decisions.reverse_if: Empirical evidence proves serverless Workers can safely execute native full git merges without external runners, or maintainers prefer raw agent PRs over invariant proofs

decisions.decision: Reject human-in-the-loop ATC UI as architectural core
decisions.reason: Reviewer attention cannot scale with token generation; human line-by-line review of 10 concurrent agent diffs causes maintainer burnout (E-C103, E-C224, E-C228)
decisions.outcome: System framed as autonomous-by-default, human-escalated by exception
decisions.reverse_if: User explicitly requires visual agent surveillance UI as contest deliverable
